title: Aprovações PABX
expected_functionality: Central de Aprovacoes - solicitacoes do PABX

sample_behaviours: CreateContactCenterPauseApprovalEvidence rejects committing a source root with no corporate children rather than accepting a merely visual all-unit claim
CreateContactCenterPauseApprovalEvidence rejects a partially inserted corporate set at the database boundary and rolls its scope back with the root
CreateContactCenterPauseApprovalEvidence accepts a complete immutable source without mistaking source existence for any policy, decision or approval
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalCoverage captures every affected unit and corporate scope rather than selecting just the operating queue
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalCoverage deduplicates units while preserving the actual memberships of multiple queues
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalCoverage keeps a stable read-only digest without creating state, requests, approvals, grants or audit events
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalIntent captures an authenticated immutable-input intent covering every affected corporate scope
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalIntent never narrows global pause approval to the selected operating queue
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalIntent creates no operational state, pending intent, approval, policy, grant or audit during preview
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalPolicyCheck rejects a real conflicting publication before it can replace a usable scoped policy or affect a pending pause
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalPolicyCheck propagates a simulated selector conflict rather than treating it as missing or ready
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReadiness projects captured operational unit names for every coherent owned scope without applying a pending pause
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReadiness keeps captured names immutable and withholds the projection after the native unit context changes
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReadiness returns no captured names after the owner loses current operating eligibility
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalSourceAccess exposes only the reviewers own scope and opaque complete-context digest rather than other units or private justification
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalSourceAccess rejects source access and a vote by a reviewer covering only the other native business unit
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalSourceAccess requires explicit Call Center approve independently of native Central decide and an ordinary administrator role
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReview retains the complete native payload and scope set unchanged in PostgreSQL
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReview rejects bulk edits to the immutable complete context without silently rewriting a historical approval
JrcContactCenter::PauseApprovalReview rejects scope movement between accounts using actual SQL rather than an ActiveRecord-only validation
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: Native mandatory pause approval API returns a no-store complete preview without creating an operational intent or a native approval
Native mandatory pause approval API requires the reviewed server digest and rejects supplied scope authority before creating anything
Native mandatory pause approval API persists and recovers the pending all-scope state through authenticated native APIs without applying it early
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: All-scope pause actual HTTP concurrency commits one canonical intent and a complete two-company request set for distinct concurrent UUIDs
All-scope pause actual HTTP concurrency recovers one exact durable intent and Central request set from duplicate concurrent confirmations
All-scope pause actual HTTP concurrency rechecks operating permissions after waiting rather than recording any partial approval request
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

sample_behaviours: Configurable approval core starts disabled for a new account and has no production catalog adapter
Configurable approval core requires native resource visibility before capturing any context, even with core management permission
Configurable approval core publishes immutable versions and pins existing requests to their original version
tests_native_related.level: Rails em PostgreSQL sintético; fornecedores podem ser substituídos nos testes

chrome_related_titles_not_complete_figur: all-scope pause approval native requires both managers, preserves ACW and denies cross-unit decisions
